allocation_complete.reason: The central BMS-relevant obligation (BMS permits the required charging power over 20-80 % SoC) has no allocated BMS requirement; the block itself names this open point.
allocation_complete.suggestion: Raise the open point with the BMS team: a BMS interface requirement publishing the permitted charging power/current.

interface_only.reason: All allocates targets are BMS_REQ_* needs tagged `interface`, imported only in bev products like the element.

no_value_copy.reason: No BMS value restated; chemistry window referenced through the allocated need.

parent_fit.reason: REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER asks for a minimum accepted average charging power; the block covers cell voltage window and thermal requests, which bound rather than deliver that power.
parent_fit.suggestion: Allocate a BMS requirement for the permitted charging power/current once the BMS team provides it.

variant_consistency.reason: In subsystems/bms (bev-only folder); parent is gated the same or weaker.
